If we have no choice about some facts, and those facts necessitate X, we have no choice about X.

Isabel is considering whether to murder her husband on Saturday by poisoning his coffee. Unbeknownst to her, Dr. Evil wants her husband dead for his own reasons. Dr. Evil knows that Isabel is considering the murder, and his preference is that she carry out the murder on Saturday on her own, so that he does not have to get his hands dirty. But, just to be safe, he arranges for a chip to be installed in Isabel’s brain which will monitor her decision-making. If Isabel decides on her own to  murder her husband on Saturday, the chip does nothing (besides monitor her thinking). But, if Isabel does not make this decision, the chip will kick into action and cause Isabel to decide on Saturday to poison the coffee and murder her husband.
